allow: PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/weapons/" -UseBasicParsing; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "武器数量: $\($data.Count\)"; $data | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $\($_.id\). $\($_.name\)" })
PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/heroes/" -UseBasicParsing; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "英雄数量: $\($data.Count\)")

PowerShell($w = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/weapons/" -UseBasicParsing\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $w | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "id=$\($_.id\) name=$\($_.name\)" }; Write-Host "---"; $h = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/heroes/" -UseBasicParsing\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $h | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "id=$\($_.id\) name=$\($_.name\)" })

PowerShell($w = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/weapons/" -UseBasicParsing\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $first = $w[0]; Write-Host "First weapon: id=$\($first.id\) name=$\($first.name\)"; $combos = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/weapons/$\($first.id\)/combos/" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Combos response: $\($combos.Content\)")

PowerShell($h = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/heroes/" -UseBasicParsing\).Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $first = $h[0]; Write-Host "First hero: id=$\($first.id\) name=$\($first.name\)"; $detail = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/heroes/$\($first.id\)/" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Detail: $\($detail.Content\)"; $matchups = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/heroes/$\($first.id\)/matchups/" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Matchups: $\($matchups.Content\)"; $combos = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/heroes/$\($first.id\)/combos/" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Combos: $\($combos.Content\)")
